harness.resolution_rule: The recorded SHA-256 must match the current path or the same path in reachable Git history.

retention_contract.whole_space_identity: RFC6962 coverage root plus instance root
retention_contract.screening_diagnostics: exact aggregate histograms plus bounded witnesses in the subject state
retention_contract.map_history: one delta per distinct instance root; repeated benchmarks do not create knowledge revisions
retention_contract.preflight_failures: invalid provenance or source mismatch fails closed before a run record exists; only failures after provenance preflight enter operational history

epistemic_contract.cold_cell: A typed combination failed one or more deterministic screening rules; it is not a falsified mathematical hypothesis.
epistemic_contract.warm_cell: A typed combination survived structural screening but still lacks the evidence needed to be a hypothesis candidate.
epistemic_contract.hot_cell: Reserved for a mechanism-assured and independently reviewed proposal; this ledger cannot create one.
epistemic_contract.completed_run: Engineering evidence that one frozen finite projection was processed reproducibly.
epistemic_contract.failed_run: Operational evidence about the pipeline, not evidence for or against an ECDLP claim.
epistemic_contract.scientific_outcome_source: experiments/engine/outcomes and typed desk decisions, never this run ledger

prohibited_inferences: typed combinations are not independently generated hypotheses
repeating an unchanged instance root is not new map coverage
a benchmark record is not ranker training data or Brier calibration data
this ledger cannot authorize execution, recommend a candidate, promote a route, or change the threat model
